title: Enhancing rice (Oryza sativa L.) yield and quality by improving photosynthesis with foliar application of zinc oxide nanoparticles
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, 12,2331-2342
DOI: 10.1039/D4EN01209G, Paper
Haipeng Zhang, Jie Chen, Xinyue Liu, Rui Wang, Hongcheng Zhang, Yanju Yang
Foliar application of ZnO NPs enhances zinc accumulation in plants while improving rice grain yield and quality by delaying leaf senescence and prolonging active photosynthetic activity.
